value.rationale: The source deliberately juxtaposes three distinct dimension-four codes with exactly the same length, dimension, and minimum distance. The complete spectra and generalized Hamming hierarchies supply the natural missing invariants that separate them: one generator-column multiset has multiplicity three, one multiplicity two, and one is projective with no three column points on a line. This is structurally informative rather than a routine parameter recomputation, and it proves pairwise monomial inequivalence within a newly published fixed-distance family.
